title: Cover
slide_intent: Give a reader a way to grasp divided authority before learning how the product works. Pair a short promise with a shape whose two halves can be distinguished at a glance.
strategic_value: Halfkey can make its name and promise easier to recall together. The solid and dotted halves give the idea of sharing a key a recognizable form.
demonstration: A white lowercase wordmark and “Give it half the key.” sit on a blue field beside a greatly enlarged symbol. The solid half is white and the dotted half is dark.
practical_value: A designer can use the cover as a reference for cropping an oversized mark while preserving the visible division that explains the name.

content_islands.name: Running header
content_islands.spec: Place the small Halfkey and Brand book identifiers near the upper-left corner of the blue field.

content_islands.name: Wordmark and promise
content_islands.spec: Set the large white lowercase wordmark on the left. Align the shorter promise below it to the same margin.

content_islands.name: Split symbol
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the white solid semicircle and dark dotted half on the right. Let the symbol extend beyond the top, bottom and right edges while keeping its vertical division visible.

content_islands.name: Edition details
content_islands.spec: Set the edition, route and date in small type at lower left.
